H4853: a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly adoom, especially singing; mental, desire
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H3245: to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3335: to mould into a form; especially as apotter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H5592: a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H4692: something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H6006: to load, i.e. impose aburden (or figuratively, infliction)
H622: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H5483: a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight)
H7392: to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H6491: to open (the senses, especially the eyes); figuratively, to be observant
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H441: familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H3595: properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H8040: properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H7223: first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H8597: ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively)
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1157: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H3782: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall
H4397: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H2580: graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty)
H5027: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H1856: to stab; by analogy, to starve; figuratively, to revile
H5594: properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail
H3173: properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced)
H4843: to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively)
H1237: properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains
H4023: Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine
H4940: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H5416: Nathan, the name of five Israelites
H8097: a Shimite (collectively) or descendants of Shimi
H7604: properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant
